out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Food stored on the floor and/or food stored less than 6 inches off the floor. THREE 5 GALLON BUCKETS STORING FOOD AND A BOX OF PRODUCE IN THE WALK-IN REFRIGERATOR ON THE GROUND.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC THAT ALL FOODS NEED TO BE AT LEAST 6 INCHES OFF OF THE GROUND TO BE PROPERLY STORED. PIC HAD EMPLOYEE MOVE THE BUCKETS AND PRODUCE TO AN EMPLTY SHELVING UNIT IN THE WALK-IN REFRIGERATOR.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: Raw shelled eggs in the 1DR prep top cooler near the pizza oven were being stored above ready to eat tahini sauce. Raw shelled eggs were also being stored above fresh cut parsley in the walk-in refrigerator.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. PIC UNDERSTANDS THAT RAW FOOD CAN NEVER BE STORED OVER RTE FOODS. PIC MOVED THE RAW SHELLED EGGS BELOW THE TAHINI SAUCE IN THE PREP TOP UNIT AND BELOW THE FRESH PARSLEY IN THE WALK-IN REFRIGERATOR.

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: multiple bulk containers of food had a scoop in them without a handle.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC WHY SCOOPS WITHOUT HANDLES ARE NOT ALLOWED TO BE USED IN FOOD STORAGE. PIC REMOVED SCOOPS FROM CONTAINERS WITHOUT HANDLES AND WILL GET SCOOPS WITH A HANDLE BY TIME OF NEXT INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Food-Contact Surfaces, Safe Materials
violations.observation: The food-contact surfaces of the following equipment and/or utensils are not safe: facility was storing clean knives in a 5 gallon buckets that was used to previously store olives.
violations.corrective_action: Materials that are used in the construction of utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment may not allow the migration of deleterious substances or impart colors, odors, or tastes to food and under normal use conditions shall be safe. PIC MOVED KNIVES TO A PROPER PLACE TO STORE THEM AND THREW OLD OLIVE BUCKET AWAY.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: EHS observed multiple holes in the ceiling, specifically above the walk-in refrigerator and above 3 vat sink, is not maintained in good repair.
violations.corrective_action: Repair the physical facilities. Poor repair and maintenance compromises the functionality of the physical facilities. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC THAT ALL HOLES MUST BE FIXED AND SEALED BY THE TIME OF NEXT INSPECTION.
